Skip to main content


The American Ever Ready Company becomes part of National Carbon Company. Hubert stays on as president. The trademark is shortened to EVEREADY ®.


1914


National Carbon Company merges with Union Carbide to form the Union Carbide and Carbon Company.


1917


EVEREADY® introduces the first miniature batteries for hearing aids.


1955
